verses.47:24: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ أَمۡ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقۡفَالُهَآ

meaning: A *qāfilah* is a company of people traveling together, often a caravan. It can refer to those starting a journey, as a good omen for their return, or those returning from one.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
